_note: Dated windows in which a DECIDER's political or economic incentives suppress or permit an action in the Iran war, each with the public fact behind it. Written 2026-10-23 from the English Wikipedia 'Timeline of the 2026 Iran war' (read through 22 Oct) and the engine's own events log. `known_from` is the first date the fact was public: a rule may only use a window on or after that date. `strength`: stated = the decider or an official said it; inferred = a pattern read from behaviour. Nothing here is a probability. A window that lapses RAISES the hazard of the act, it does not fire it.

acts.us_strike_iran: US acknowledged strike on Iranian territory (land targets, islands, launchers)
acts.il_strike_iran: Israeli acknowledged or credibly attributed strike on Iranian territory
acts.ir_attack_us_forces: Iranian attack that hits US forces or bases
acts.ir_ship_attack: Iranian attack on merchant shipping in or near Hormuz

windows.fact: Trump agrees a two-week ceasefire in exchange for reopening Hormuz (4/7); extends it at Pakistan's request (4/21); 5/6 pauses Project Freedom citing 'great progress'; CENTCOM 5/25 says the ceasefire remains
windows.trigger: Iranian attacks on US ships or forces (US destroyers 5/4-5/7) bring limited 'self-defense' strikes, not a campaign

windows.fact: Islamabad Memorandum signed 6/17; 6/28 the US and Iran agree to halt exchanges
windows.ended_by: 7/7 Iranian missiles hit commercial vessels incl. Qatar's Al Rekayyat; Trump declares the MOU over 7/8

windows.fact: Pause in strikes after 13 nights; Waltz: it allowed room for diplomacy; Iran says it will halt if the US does
windows.trigger: an Iranian attack on US forces
windows.ended_by: 7/29 retaliatory strikes after a foiled attack on Jordan

windows.fact: Trump says he and Israel called off a planned attack at Iran's request (8/2); Rubio 8/25: major combat not expected 'for the time being'; Gulf states and the Oman framework (8/6) back a diplomatic track
windows.trigger: an Iranian attack on US troops
windows.ended_by: 8/30 Larak launchers struck, 8/31 Iranian attack on US soldiers in Jordan; round 3

windows.fact: No US strikes on Iranian land after round 3 ended in early September (AFP 10/24: no major strikes on land targets since early September; the exact 9/10 start is the engine's inference, unsourced); Trump willing to negotiate (9/14), expects talks (9/27), 'always open' (10/5); Iran gave mediators conditions via Qatar 9/19
windows.trigger: an Iranian attack that kills US personnel

windows.fact: Trump: the US 'will not be attacking Iran at any time prior to the Midterm Elections' (10/8); a White House official repeats it 10/22; two senior Iranian officials tell Reuters (10/14) the tanker attacks aim to keep prices high and influence the midterms, and the Washington Post (10/18) reports Tehran front-loading the pain before the vote. [10/25: the 'Reuters 10/20' citation could not be found and is replaced by WaPo 10/18]
windows.trigger: an Iranian attack that kills US personnel or hits US bases; a reversal of the pledge

windows.fact: NYT (10/21-22): Trump has repeatedly vetoed a return to major combat and wants refineries spared, with gasoline ~$4.27-4.30 (first October ever above $4) and Brent above 110; at rallies he says the US may hit Iran 'a little bit further' (10/22) and 'another little Epic Fury' (10/23). [10/25: the 10/22 NewsNation 'temporarily postpones major combat operations' statement could not be re-sourced, so this window is downgraded from stated to inferred; the 10/8 pledge alone carries the suppression to 11/3]
windows.trigger: a sharp fall in prices or an Iranian attack that makes the political cost of inaction higher

windows.fact: FT 10/21: Netanyahu planned a multi-day offensive for the weekend of 10/10 before Israel's 10/27 election and Trump opposed escalation before the midterms; Netanyahu then said a strike before the vote was 'not convenient for us'; an Israeli security chief warned a strike could postpone the election

NYT 10/21: US and Israeli plans for post-midterm strikes on energy, nuclear and missile sites, 'slim chance' of action in October; 10/22: forces have finalized plans for a possible three-day strike on nuclear facilities and Trump hints at post-election escalation
windows.trigger: none needed: a lapsed window raises the hazard, it does not fire it

windows.fact: Two senior Iranian officials tell Reuters (10/14) the tanker strikes aim to keep energy prices high and pressure Trump before the midterms; the Washington Post (10/18) reports Tehran front-loading the pain because it expects Trump to care less about prices after the vote; October is the war's worst month for shipping, 27 attacks on commercial ships by IMO count as of 10/22 (UKMTO: 15 in 10/6-10/14). [10/25: 'Reuters 10/20' replaced by WaPo 10/18]
windows.trigger: none: Iran escalates at sea and stays below the line (US casualties) that would end US restraint

Iran declares Hormuz closed and fires at US sites in Kuwait, Bahrain, Jordan
Iran fires at Ali Al Salem and the Fifth Fleet HQ
Iranian missiles hit commercial vessels; MOU over 7/8
Iranian missiles on Muwaffaq Salti; two US soldiers killed 7/17-18
